hook_text: There is a farm in the middle of the city, and you would never know. It is on the roof.
clip_script: Khayelitsha, Cape Town. Between the houses, a group of gogos turn sandy land into rows of spinach, onions and carrots. In Johannesburg, a rooftop garden grows lettuce above the traffic. At a school in Soweto, Grade 4s water a keyhole garden. In a tiny yard, tomatoes grow in old paint tins. Growing food in towns and cities saves money, gives fresh food and turns empty spaces green. Where could you grow something?
visual_style: Whiteboard city skyline with green patches appearing: between houses, on rooftops, in school yards and in tins on a windowsill.
mood: Hopeful and green, like a city coming to life.
pacing: One place at a time, from a community garden to a rooftop to a tin, then the benefits.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and plant a seed in a container at home.
